ideas.pitch: Real-time edge-AI acoustic monitoring and panic-route generator for women safety in poorly lit urban zones.
ideas.title: SurakshaNet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a deeply felt societal issue in India, appealing directly to the local judges at Acropolis Institute by integrating cheap CCTV/audio feeds with spatial risk mapping.

ideas.pitch: Multilingual vernacular voice-agent for rural classrooms providing interactive NCERT textbook Q&A via low-bandwidth telephony APIs.
ideas.title: GramVani
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves accessibility constraints of rural India using high-impact audio intelligence that works on basic feature phones or low-spec web clients.

ideas.pitch: Offline-capable multi-spectral leaf disease and soil degradation classifier tailored for local Indore agricultural yields.
ideas.title: CropShield AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly impacts regional agricultural productivity in Madhya Pradesh, giving judges a tangible, localized prototype they can immediately test with mobile photos.

ideas.title: ArogyaSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses severe overcrowding in public healthcare settings through a pragmatic workflow optimization engine that hospital administrators and judges instantly understand.
